rows.note: Use 毅力 as the all-purpose noun for the ability to keep going despite setbacks.

example.english: Despite repeated failures, I still completed the plan through perseverance.
example.traditional: 面對一次又一次失敗，我仲係靠毅力完成咗個計劃。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 sat1 baai6 ngo5 zung6 hai6 kaau3 ngai6 lik6 jyun4 sing4 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use 堅持 when focusing on maintaining a course or position rather than on the personal quality behind it.

example.english: No matter how much others object, I will stick to my decision with perseverance.
example.traditional: 無論人哋點反對，我都會堅持自己嘅決定。
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 jan4 dei6 dim2 faan2 deoi3 ngo5 dou1 wui6 gin1 ci4 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use 恆心 when emphasizing steady, sustained dedication over time.

example.english: The most important thing in learning an instrument is perseverance; you only improve by practising a little every day.
example.traditional: 學樂器最重要係有恆心，日日練少少先會進步。
example.jyutping: hok6 ngok6 hei3 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 jau5 hang4 sam1 jat6 jat6 lin6 siu2 siu2 sin1 wui5 zeon3 bou6
